## Interfaces

- `tabs_for` / `PhaseDetail.spec_body|design_body|structured` from spec-model consumed by PhaseScreen pane composition and Spec/Design rendering.
- `load_decision_log(target, effort, phase|None, history)` consumed by DecisionsPane with a/h toggles.
- `pager_command` / `page_text` from spec-pager wired to PhaseScreen `o` with App.suspend(); temp file outside store and unlinked.
- Main-screen `p`/`s`/`e` push PhaseScreen; task_detail phase link uses PhaseScreen; old PhaseDetailScreen removed.

## Assumptions

- Textual TabbedContent pane removal before mount and left/right bindings work from content focus (pilots green).
- App.suspend() available for pager (stubbed in tests).
- Wave-1 model/pager APIs stable for PhaseScreen (regression tests still pass).

## Invariants

- PhaseScreen remains read-only; pager temp file never under `.artifacts` and always removed.
- Missing specification type degrades to simple tab set.
- RequirementDetailScreen and TaskDetailScreen reused unchanged.

## Conflicts

none
